description: This file contains an abstract test runner class for Orleans transaction attribution, with multiple test methods verifying transaction context behaviors under different scenarios.

classes.name: TransactionAttributionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing a suite of unit tests for verifying transaction attribution behaviors in Orleans, focusing on different transaction options and contexts.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromOutsideTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests transaction context behavior when calling from outside a transaction with various attribution options.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromWithinTransactionTest
methods.description: Tests transaction context behavior when calling from within a transaction with various attribution options.

methods.name: CreateOrJoinTest
methods.description: Verifies that CreateOrJoin transaction options share the same transaction context.

methods.name: CreateTest
methods.description: Verifies that Create transaction options generate distinct transaction contexts.

methods.name: SupportedTest
methods.description: Checks that 'Supported' attribution options correctly join the parent transaction.

methods.name: JoinFailTest
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to join a transaction with 'Join' option fails appropriately.

methods.name: NotAllowedFailTest
methods.description: Verifies that 'NotAllowed' attribution options throw the expected exception.
